description: This file is the entry point for a React web application. It imports core React libraries, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It initializes the React app by rendering the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' within a React.StrictMode component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree into a DOM container.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the root container.
